structured.answer: Open an account at Pesagot (פסגות) and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", the page's "הזול" (cheapest) pick; it says I'd be left with about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That's on the page's preset 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month, not my 30,000.
